meaning.vi: Với sự hung hăng; dã man.

sentences.en: Truculently she pushed her hands through the glossy waves and then froze, suddenly aware of Lucenzo's prolonged intake of breath.

sentences.en: The boy looked up truculently at his teacher.
sentences.vi: Cậu bé ngây ngô nhìn lên người thầy của mình.

sentences.en: Two Truckee truckers truculently truckling to have truck to truck two trucks of truck.
